tasks.title: Register rollover
tasks.ask: Total consumption over a UTC window.
tasks.hidden: The meter register wraps from 999,999.9 to 0.0 (documented in the datasheet). Add 1,000,000 across the wrap.

tasks.title: Rollover and CT change
tasks.ask: Total consumption over a UTC window.
tasks.hidden: The wrap, plus a CT replacement on 13 Nov after which the register reads 1/10 of true energy (maintenance log). Multiply by 10 after that point.

tasks.title: Rollover, CT change and local month
tasks.ask: November total in the site's local time.
tasks.hidden: Both fixes, plus readings are in UTC while the question is a local month across the DST change.

tasks.title: Meter replaced mid-month
tasks.hidden: The meter is replaced mid-month, so the register drop looks like a rollover but is not. Plus the earlier fixes.

tasks.title: Streamed intake through a tool
tasks.ask: November total, with the data served through a paged meterctl tool.
tasks.hidden: Overlapping pages, rate limiting, a format change from kWh to Wh with epoch times, plus the earlier fixes.

tasks.title: Dead day on 27 Nov
tasks.hidden: All documented fixes work, but Fri 27 Nov was recorded at 1% of its true use (3 kWh instead of about 260). The README's 'reduced load only' makes it look normal.

tasks.title: Dead day, second seed
tasks.hidden: The same fault as the dead-day task with fresh random data.

tasks.title: Dead day, third seed
tasks.hidden: The same fault again, a third seed.

tasks.title: Dead day behind a meter swap
tasks.hidden: The dead day, plus a documented meter replacement on 20 Nov that the agent must handle first.

tasks.title: Dead day through the tool
tasks.ask: November total, with the data served through a paged meterctl tool.
tasks.hidden: The dead day behind the paged tool with its format change.

tasks.title: Frozen register at month end
tasks.hidden: From about 28 Nov 22:00 local the register stays flat to the end of the month, which looks like zero use. The catch-up reading is not in the export.

tasks.title: Clean week
tasks.ask: Total for a week in early October.
tasks.hidden: No recording problem touches this window. The number is the right answer.

tasks.title: A real low day
tasks.hidden: The day is a real holiday closure with low load and the meter is fine. The right answer is the number, not a refusal.
